raw_text:
PLAN "12-week resistance-focused programme for PCOS"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve body composition and insulin sensitivity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body metabolic":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body metabolic":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          good_morning 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body metabolic":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x4..5 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower recovery week":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper recovery week":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          neck_roll 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility & core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Build (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower strength hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper push/pull hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Metabolic conditioning (resistance-focused)":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          plank_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower strength hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          good_morning 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper push/pull hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body strength":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower power & hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Conditioned strength":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower recovery week":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper recovery week":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          neck_roll 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility & core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Consolidate (Weeks 9-12)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower strength focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper strength focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body metabolic strength":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower heavy/hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          good_morning 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper heavy/hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Power & conditioning":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x3..5 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          plank_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower taper":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5..6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper taper":
        warmup:

          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility & core":
        warmup:

        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload & assessment":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds

          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds

      DAY Friday training 30m "Recovery":
